facts.text: The hotel is located on Doha's longest beach and nestled in landscaped gardens.
facts.excerpt: Located on Doha's longest beach and nestled in landscaped gardens

facts.text: The Bay Club offers Doha's longest private beach, a pool, a 24-hour gym, padel, tennis and squash courts, fitness classes and watersports.
facts.excerpt: Soak in the sunshine at Doha's longest private beach, or relax by the pool. The Bay Club offers endless recreation options like a state-of-the-art 24-hour gym, padel, tennis, and squash courts, fitness classes, watersports, and more.

facts.text: Spa InterContinental has treatment rooms and suites, a private indoor pool, hot tub, sauna and steam facilities, plus separate relaxation rooms.
facts.excerpt: featuring 16 treatment rooms and suites, private indoor pool, hot tub, sauna, and steam facilities. After your treatment, head to the Spa's separate relaxation rooms to unwind.

facts.text: The outdoor pool is a free-form pool at The Bay Club.
facts.excerpt: Free-form pool at The Bay Club.

facts.text: Rooms are designed as luxurious, modern, comfortable and fresh with an Arabic twist, with sleek spa-like bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: Our furnished rooms are designed as luxurious, modern, comfortable, and fresh with an Arabic twist. Rooms feature 40-inch LED TV, smart connectivity, complimentary Wi-Fi internet connection, sleek spa-like bathrooms, and premium amenities.

facts.text: Suites such as the Ocean Suite may include a sea view and a separate bath and walk-in shower.
facts.excerpt:
Ocean Suite may include:

- Sea View
- Separate Bath and Walk-in Shower

facts.text: Club InterContinental, for guests in Club rooms and suites, offers complimentary breakfast, light refreshments, afternoon tea and evening cocktails, in a lounge overlooking the Doha skyline.
facts.excerpt: Available exclusively to guests staying in one of our Club rooms and suites, Club InterContinental offers complimentary breakfast, light refreshments, afternoon tea, and evening cocktails. Overlooking the stunning Doha skyline

facts.text: La Mar Doha by Gaston Acurio is a Michelin-recommended beachfront restaurant serving contemporary Peruvian cuisine with panoramic skyline views.
facts.excerpt: La Mar Doha by Gaston Acurio, a Michelin recommended restaurant, is the citys destination for contemporary Peruvian cuisine.

facts.text: La Mar Beach is a beach lounge with views of the West Bay skyline and the Arabian Gulf, with cabanas, sunbeds and a temperature-controlled pool.
facts.excerpt: La Mar Beach is a chic, contemporary beach lounge offering unmatched views of the West Bay skyline and the Arabian Gulf. Designed with modern elegance, it features stylish cabanas, comfortable sunbeds and a temperature controlled pool

facts.text: Mykonos is a Greek taverna whose olive-tree-framed terrace overlooks the pool and beach, with bouzouki music.
facts.excerpt: The terrace, framed by olive trees and overlooking the pool and beach, is accompanied by enchanting bouzouki music for an authentic Mediterranean escape.

facts.text: The hotel is minutes from Lusail, downtown Doha, the Doha Exhibition and Convention Centre, City Center Mall and Doha Golf Club, and Al Qassar Metro Station is a short walk away.
facts.excerpt: Our prime location is just minutes from Lusail, downtown Doha, the Doha Exhibition and Convention Centre, City Center Mall, and Doha Golf Club. The Al Qassar Metro Station is also a short walk away.

facts.text: Katara Cultural Village is about 1 kilometer from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Katara Cultural Village - 0.62 miles away (1 kilometers)

facts.text: The Bay Club has a children's pool and playground.
facts.excerpt: longest private beach, outdoor pool, children's pool and playground, health club, tennis courts, and Spa InterContinental

facts.text: The concierge can book a three-hour guided city tour of Doha.
facts.excerpt: Our Concierge team are happy to assist you in booking your guided city tour.

facts.text: The beach gets very hot in summer, and the hotel recommends spending time by its chilled pool then.
facts.excerpt: Over the summer, the temperature spikes up so we recommend spending time by our chilled pool.

facts.text: Pets are not accommodated, except for guide dogs.
facts.excerpt: We regret that we are unable to accommodate pets, except for guide dogs.

facts.text: The minimum check-in age is 21.
facts.excerpt: **Minimum check-in age**: 21

facts.text: The hotel holds Green Key sustainability certification.
facts.excerpt: Certifications: Green Key (FEE)

facts.text: La Vue is a lounge overlooking Doha's skyline with cocktails, wines, cigars, whiskies and cognacs.
facts.excerpt: La Vue is a sophisticated lounge overlooking Doha’s skyline

facts.text: The hotel has 12 restaurants and bars.
facts.excerpt: We currently have 12 restaurants and bars

facts.text: The hotel has 10 restaurants and bars.
facts.excerpt: with 10 restaurants and bars
